# 565. Array Nesting

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(n))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def arrayNesting(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        n = len(nums)
        ans = 0
        vis = [0 for _ in range(n)]
        for i in range(n):
            cnt = 0
            while not vis[i]:
                vis[i] = True
                i = nums[i]
                cnt += 1
            ans = max(ans, cnt)
        return ans
```
